name: Client order lifecycle tracking fulfillment
objective: Make every client order read, tracking, fulfillment and exception state a privacy-safe projection of one versioned DSH state machine written only by authorized actors.
truthOwner: DSH order/dispatch/custody truth; bounded partner/captain/operator writers; WLT owns financial consequences

tasks.objective: Close owned order reads and deep-link authorization.
tasks.currentProblem: Guessed IDs, stale action availability or deep links can bypass current owned order/version truth.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace list/detail/action/deep-link through DSH owner and re-authorize exact object/version on read/action.
tasks.targetState: Client sees only owned current order state and server-authorized actions.
tasks.action: Fix order read/action owner first then bounded client navigation.
tasks.rollback: Never restore local order state machine.

tasks.objective: Close legal versioned cross-surface fulfillment transitions.
tasks.currentProblem: Partner/captain/operator retries or stale versions can race on the same order.
tasks.requiredChange: Enforce permission, predecessor state, version/idempotency and custody/proof invariants at DSH transition owner.
tasks.targetState: Each authorized transition has one legal effect and all surfaces converge.
tasks.action: Test preparation assignment handoff pickup proof delivery with stale/out-of-order/duplicate operations.
acceptanceCriteria: Client and writers converge same version

tasks.objective: Close cancellation return exception reassignment and privacy.
tasks.currentProblem: Non-happy paths can split order/dispatch/WLT state or expose tracking/proof outside authorized lifecycle.
tasks.requiredChange: Make sagas retry-safe with canonical compensation/readback and gate location/contact/proof by owned order/lifecycle.
tasks.targetState: Exception paths converge or remain explicit pending without false completion/privacy leak.
tasks.action: Red-team cancellation return reassignment race and unauthorized tracking/proof reads.
tasks.rollback: Never restore a privacy or double-effect defect.
